dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Noo, we didn't make it! This exam was way too hard.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: It's alright! This was the Expert exam, after all. It's really difficult to pass on your first try.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'll come back once you've had some more time to prepare. Keep at it! I know you'll succeed in the end!

choices.text: We went over the steps in the wrong order...
